name: Gilded Coral Palace Hidden in an Underwater Canyon
description: A magnificent palace made of gleaming coral and pearl, hidden within a deep underwater canyon, waterfalls of iridescent water cascade over its towers, sea creatures glide through arches.
prompt: Underwater canyon full of ancient coral palace, towers carved from gleaming coral and mother-of-pearl, waterfalls of sparkling water flowing down the walls, schools of colorful fish swimming through arches, shafts of sunlight filtering through surface, hyperrealistic, deep sea fantasy, 8K detail.
caption: A hidden underwater kingdom of coral gold 🌊✨ Explore the palace where every wall sings with ocean treasure.
